entities.name: Sabiha al-Shaykh Da'ud
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sabiha al-Shaykh Da'ud (1912–1975) was Iraq's first female law graduate and a prominent women's rights activist. She and Zakia Hakki became the first female judges in Iraq respectively in 1956–1959.
